description: A progressive, practice-first curriculum. Each stage moves from concepts to a small implementation and a checkable result. Use current official documentation for version-sensitive details.

tracks.title: Programming foundations

stages.goal: Write small programs and explain their behavior.

lessons.practice: Build a command-line unit converter; test normal, boundary, and invalid input.

lessons.practice: Split a text statistics tool into small functions with clear inputs and outputs.

stages.goal: Reason about performance, concurrency, and design tradeoffs.

lessons.title: Algorithms and profiling
lessons.practice: Benchmark two solutions and explain time and memory costs.

lessons.title: Concurrency and architecture
lessons.practice: Design a bounded worker queue and test cancellation and failure cases.

lessons.title: Bounded worker queues
lessons.practice: Design a worker pool with fixed queue capacity, cancellation, and graceful shutdown. Test saturation, worker failure, and shutdown with queued work.

lessons.practice: Create a line-oriented calculator with strict input checks.

lessons.title: Arrays and strings
lessons.practice: Write a safe string length and copy routine with boundary tests.

lessons.title: Worked exercise: normalize integer lists in C
lessons.practice: Implement the shared comma-separated integer-list contract in C: print sorted unique signed 32-bit integers as JSON, print [] for empty input, and reject malformed or out-of-range tokens. Then change the output order to descending and verify the empty, duplicate, malformed, and boundary cases.
steps: Read one complete input line and define what empty input means.
Split the line into tokens, trim surrounding whitespace, and parse each token without silently accepting trailing characters.
Reject malformed values and values outside the signed 32-bit range before storing them.
Sort the values, remove duplicates, and serialize one JSON array.
Test empty input, duplicates, negatives, minimum and maximum values, an empty token, and overflow; then change sorting to descending and rerun the tests.

lessons.title: Safe dynamic buffers
lessons.practice: Read an arbitrarily long line into a growing buffer. Preserve the original pointer on realloc failure and check capacity arithmetic for overflow.

stages.goal: Manage memory and split a program into modules.

lessons.title: Sanitizers and performance
lessons.practice: Find and fix memory errors with address/undefined sanitizers.

lessons.title: Partial socket writes
lessons.practice: Implement a bounded TCP response loop that handles partial sends, interrupted calls, disconnects, and cleanup. Test a client that closes mid-response.
